sentences.p: Wǒ jiào Ivan, nǐ ne?
sentences.e: My name is Ivan — and you?

sentences.p: Wǒ jīnnián èrshí'èr suì.
sentences.e: I'm twenty-two this year.

sentences.p: Wǒ shì Xiānggǎng rén.
sentences.e: I'm from Hong Kong.

sentences.p: Wǒ shì yí ge xuéshēng.
sentences.e: I am a student.

sentences.p: Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
sentences.e: What's your name?

sentences.p: Wǒ yào qù gōngyuán.
sentences.e: I'm going to the park.

sentences.p: Yīnwèi tā yào zuò gōngkè.
sentences.e: Because he has to do his homework.

sentences.p: Tāmen yào qù shuìjiào.
sentences.e: They need to go to sleep.

sentences.p: Tāmen kěyǐ zìjǐ chīfàn.
sentences.e: They can eat by themselves.

sentences.p: Wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ chīfàn.
sentences.e: I want to eat by myself.

sentences.p: Nǐmen yào bāng wǒmen mǎi wàimài.
sentences.e: You have to help us buy takeout.

sentences.p: Yīnwèi wǒ xiǎng gēn tā qù gōngyuán.
sentences.e: Because I want to go to the park with him.

sentences.p: Nǐ kěyǐ zìjǐ chūqù chīfàn.
sentences.e: You can go out and eat by yourself.

sentences.h: 我下个星期要出去买苹果。
sentences.p: Wǒ xià ge xīngqī yào chūqù mǎi píngguǒ.
sentences.e: I need to go out and buy apples next week.

sentences.p: Nǐ fùmǔ yǒu jǐ ge háizi?
sentences.e: How many children do your parents have?

sentences.h: 他们有两个孩子，我有一个哥哥。
sentences.p: Tāmen yǒu liǎng ge háizi, wǒ yǒu yí ge gēge.
sentences.e: They have two children; I have one older brother.

sentences.p: Nǐ gēge jǐ suì le?
sentences.e: How old is your brother?

sentences.p: Nǐ gēge jiéhūn le ma?
sentences.e: Is your brother married?

sentences.p: Jiéhūn le, tā yǒu yí ge érzi.
sentences.e: He's married, and he has a son.

sentences.p: Nǐ yéye nǎinai hái zài ma?
sentences.e: Are your grandparents still with us?

sentences.h: 我爷爷很久以前去世了，我奶奶还在。
sentences.p: Wǒ yéye hěn jiǔ yǐqián qùshì le, wǒ nǎinai hái zài.
sentences.e: My grandfather passed away a long time ago; my grandmother is still alive.

sentences.p: Nǐ nǎinai xiànzài duō dà?
sentences.e: How old is your grandmother now?

sentences.p: Zhèlǐ de shíwù hái búcuò.
sentences.e: The food here is pretty good.

sentences.p: Tāmen de jiā hěn dà.
sentences.e: Their home is very big.

sentences.p: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō xīn yīfu.
sentences.e: I have a lot of new clothes.

sentences.h: 我朋友下个礼拜可以帮我。
sentences.p: Wǒ péngyou xià ge lǐbài kěyǐ bāng wǒ.
sentences.e: My friend can help me next week.

sentences.h: 现在我和我的家人住在一起。
sentences.p: Xiànzài wǒ hé wǒ de jiārén zhù zài yìqǐ.
sentences.e: Right now I live with my family.

sentences.p: Bàba xiǎng tīng tā zìjǐ de gē.
sentences.e: Dad wants to listen to his own songs.

sentences.p: Wǒ xiǎng yòng wǒmen de xǐwǎnjī.
sentences.e: I want to use our dishwasher.

sentences.h: 我的女朋友有很多问题要问。
sentences.p: Wǒ de nǚpéngyou yǒu hěn duō wèntí yào wèn.
sentences.e: My girlfriend has a lot of questions to ask.

sentences.p: Wǒmen de diànnǎo fēicháng hǎo.
sentences.e: Our computer is very good.

sentences.p: Tāmen de bàba xiǎng chūqù.
sentences.e: Their dad wants to go out.

sentences.p: Wǒ xiǎng tīng wǒ māma de xīn gē.
sentences.e: I want to listen to my mum's new songs.

sentences.p: Wǒ hěn xiǎng chūqù.
sentences.e: I really want to go out.

sentences.h: 我喜欢自己住，因为我喜欢有属于自己的地方。
sentences.p: Wǒ xǐhuan zìjǐ zhù, yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuan yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de dìfang.
sentences.e: I like living by myself because I like having my own place.

sentences.p: Huānyíng guānglín, qǐngwèn jǐ wèi?
sentences.e: Welcome — how many in your party?

sentences.p: Liǎng wèi, xièxie.
sentences.e: Two, thank you.

sentences.p: Qǐngwèn yǒu dìngwèi ma?
sentences.e: Do you have a reservation?

sentences.h: 那可能需要您等十几分钟，可以吗？
sentences.p: Nà kěnéng xūyào nín děng shí jǐ fēnzhōng, kěyǐ ma?
sentences.e: Then you may need to wait ten-odd minutes — is that alright?

sentences.h: 不好意思，让你们久等了。
sentences.p: Bù hǎoyìsi, ràng nǐmen jiǔ děng le.
sentences.e: Sorry to have kept you waiting.

sentences.h: 这边请。这是我们的菜单。
sentences.p: Zhèbiān qǐng. Zhè shì wǒmen de càidān.
sentences.e: This way please. Here is our menu.

sentences.p: Qǐngwèn yǒu shénme tuījiàn?
sentences.e: Do you have any recommendations?

sentences.h: 炸酱面是我们的招牌菜。
sentences.p: Zhájiàngmiàn shì wǒmen de zhāopáicài.
sentences.e: Zhajiangmian is our signature dish.

sentences.h: 你们可以尝试一下，味道不错。
sentences.p: Nǐmen kěyǐ chángshì yíxià, wèidào búcuò.
sentences.e: You can give it a try — it tastes pretty good.

sentences.h: 请问这道炸酱面有花生吗？我对花生过敏。
sentences.p: Qǐngwèn zhè dào zhájiàngmiàn yǒu huāshēng ma? Wǒ duì huāshēng guòmǐn.
sentences.e: Does this zhajiangmian have peanuts? I'm allergic to peanuts.

sentences.h: 明白，我们可以不加花生。
sentences.p: Míngbai, wǒmen kěyǐ bù jiā huāshēng.
sentences.e: Understood, we can make it without peanuts.

sentences.p: Hái yào diǎn qítā cài ma?
sentences.e: Would you like to order anything else?

sentences.h: 我朋友是吃素的，有没有适合他的菜？
sentences.p: Wǒ péngyou shì chī sù de, yǒu méiyǒu shìhé tā de cài?
sentences.e: My friend is vegetarian — do you have any dishes suitable for him?

sentences.h: 当然有，我们有素食菜单：麻婆豆腐、炒西兰花等等。
sentences.p: Dāngrán yǒu, wǒmen yǒu sùshí càidān: mápó dòufu, chǎo xīlánhuā děngděng.
sentences.e: Of course — we have a vegetarian menu: mapo tofu, stir-fried broccoli and so on.

sentences.p: Lái yí fèn chǎo xīlánhuā.
sentences.e: One portion of stir-fried broccoli, please.

sentences.p: Hǎo de, qǐngwèn nǐ yào yǐnliào ma?
sentences.e: Alright — would you like anything to drink?

sentences.p: Liǎng bēi bīngshuǐ jiù hǎo, xièxie.
sentences.e: Two glasses of iced water will be fine, thanks.

sentences.p: Niúpái bǐjiào hǎochī.
sentences.e: The steak tastes better.

sentences.p: Wǒ zài zuò gōngkè.
sentences.e: I'm doing my homework.

sentences.p: Biǎogē zài chīfàn.
sentences.e: My cousin is eating.

sentences.p: Tā yǐjīng bìyè le.
sentences.e: He's already graduated.

sentences.h: 表弟和他的女朋友已经分手了。
sentences.p: Biǎodì hé tā de nǚpéngyou yǐjīng fēnshǒu le.
sentences.e: My cousin and his girlfriend have already broken up.

sentences.p: Nǐ kě bu kěyǐ hé wǒ chūqù?
sentences.e: Can you come out with me?

sentences.p: Wǒ dào jiā le.
sentences.e: I've arrived home.

sentences.h: 他和我已经穿好衣服了。
sentences.p: Tā hé wǒ yǐjīng chuān hǎo yīfu le.
sentences.e: He and I are already dressed.

sentences.p: Yīnwèi wǒ zài ná nǐ de shūbāo.
sentences.e: Because I'm grabbing your backpack.

sentences.p: Nǐ yào děng wǒ! Wǒ zài guòlái.
sentences.e: Wait for me! I'm on my way.

sentences.h: 听说你还在读大学，你在读什么专业？
sentences.p: Tīngshuō nǐ hái zài dú dàxué, nǐ zài dú shénme zhuānyè?
sentences.e: I heard you're still at university — what are you majoring in?

sentences.p: Wǒ xiànzài dú jīnróng.
sentences.e: I'm studying finance at the moment.

sentences.p: A, jīnróng, tīng qǐlái hěn nán a.
sentences.e: Ah, finance — that sounds hard.

sentences.h: 是啊，有时候挺难的，但是也很有趣。
sentences.p: Shì a, yǒu shíhou tǐng nán de, dànshì yě hěn yǒuqù.
sentences.e: Yes, sometimes it's quite hard, but it's also very interesting.

sentences.p: Nà nǐ xiànzài dú jǐ niánjí le?
sentences.e: So what year are you in now?

sentences.p: Wǒ xiànzài zài dú dà sì.
sentences.e: I'm in my fourth year.

sentences.h: 是的，我还有一年就毕业了。
sentences.p: Shì de, wǒ hái yǒu yì nián jiù bìyè le.
sentences.e: Yes, I have one more year until I graduate.

sentences.h: 那你毕业之后想做什么呢？
sentences.p: Nà nǐ bìyè zhīhòu xiǎng zuò shénme ne?
sentences.e: So what do you want to do after you graduate?

sentences.p: Tīng qǐlái tǐng búcuò de.
sentences.e: That sounds pretty good.

sentences.p: Nǐ de Guǎngdōnghuà búcuò.
sentences.e: Your Cantonese isn't bad.

sentences.p: Gēge méiyǒu chūqù.
sentences.e: My brother didn't go out.

sentences.p: Yǒu méiyǒu wèntí?
sentences.e: Is there a problem?

sentences.p: Bāng wǒ ná.
sentences.e: Help me carry it.

sentences.p: Nǐ yídìng yào chuān yí jiàn wàitào.
sentences.e: You must wear a jacket.

sentences.p: Mèimei jīnwǎn bù xiǎng guòlái.
sentences.e: My sister doesn't want to come over tonight.

sentences.p: Wǒ zài chāojí shìchǎng lǐ.
sentences.e: I'm inside the supermarket.

sentences.p: Wǒ hái méi qù guo nǐ jiā.
sentences.e: I haven't been to your place yet.

sentences.h: 服务员，我想打包，麻烦帮我拿一个盒子过来。
sentences.p: Fúwùyuán, wǒ xiǎng dǎbāo, máfan bāng wǒ ná yí ge hézi guòlái.
sentences.e: Waiter, I'd like to pack this up — could you bring me a box?

sentences.p: Shùnbiàn mǎidān, xièxie.
sentences.e: And the bill while you're at it, thanks.

sentences.h: 请问您想刷卡还是现金结账？
sentences.p: Qǐngwèn nín xiǎng shuākǎ háishi xiànjīn jiézhàng?
sentences.e: Would you like to pay by card or cash?

sentences.p: Wǒ yòng xìnyòngkǎ zhīfù.
sentences.e: I'll pay by credit card.

sentences.h: 好的，总共是三百元，请在这里拍卡。
sentences.p: Hǎo de, zǒnggòng shì sānbǎi yuán, qǐng zài zhèlǐ pāi kǎ.
sentences.e: Alright, that's 300 yuan in total — please tap your card here.

sentences.p: Huānyíng xiàcì zài lái. Qǐng màn zǒu.
sentences.e: Please come again. Take care.

sentences.p: Nǐ zài zuò shénme?
sentences.e: What are you doing?

sentences.p: Nǐmen jīnwǎn xiǎng hē shénme?
sentences.e: What do you want to drink tonight?

sentences.h: 我不知道我今晚想吃什么。
sentences.p: Wǒ bù zhīdào wǒ jīnwǎn xiǎng chī shénme.
sentences.e: I don't know what I want to eat tonight.

sentences.h: 看什么电视？你要去看书。
sentences.p: Kàn shénme diànshì? Nǐ yào qù kàn shū.
sentences.e: What are you watching TV for? You need to go and study.

sentences.p: Wǒ yǒu dōngxi yào qù zuò.
sentences.e: I have something to do.

sentences.p: Wǒ shàng ge xīngqī mǎi le dōngxi.
sentences.e: I bought something last week.

sentences.p: Tā yǒu dōngxi yào gěi nǐ.
sentences.e: He has something to give you.

sentences.p: Wǒ gěi nǐ yì bēi shuǐ.
sentences.e: I'll give you a glass of water.

sentences.p: Wǒ jīnwǎn shénme dōu bù xiǎng zuò.
sentences.e: I don't want to do anything tonight.

sentences.p: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan chī shénme cài?
sentences.e: What's your favourite kind of food?

sentences.h: 我最喜欢吃越南菜和日本菜。
sentences.p: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī Yuènán cài hé Rìběn cài.
sentences.e: I like Vietnamese and Japanese food the most.

sentences.p: Nǐ píngshí chī zhōngcān ma?
sentences.e: Do you usually eat Chinese food?

sentences.h: 有时候会吃中餐，但是不会每天都吃。
sentences.p: Yǒu shíhou huì chī zhōngcān, dànshì bú huì měitiān dōu chī.
sentences.e: Sometimes I eat Chinese food, but not every day.

sentences.h: 我喜欢吃有点辣的东西，不过不可以吃太辣的。
sentences.p: Wǒ xǐhuan chī yǒudiǎn là de dōngxi, búguò bù kěyǐ chī tài là de.
sentences.e: I like slightly spicy food, but I can't handle it too spicy.

sentences.h: 我喜欢吃点心、糖醋排骨和烤鸭。
sentences.p: Wǒ xǐhuan chī diǎnxin, tángcù páigǔ hé kǎoyā.
sentences.e: I like dim sum, sweet and sour pork ribs and roast duck.

sentences.h: 那我有空煮一下给你吃吧。
sentences.p: Nà wǒ yǒukòng zhǔ yíxià gěi nǐ chī ba.
sentences.e: Then I'll cook some for you when I have time.

sentences.p: Shéi hái méi xǐ wǎn?
sentences.e: Who hasn't washed the dishes yet?

sentences.h: 谢谢妈妈，你对我太好了。
sentences.p: Xièxie māma, nǐ duì wǒ tài hǎo le.
sentences.e: Thanks Mum, you're too good to me.

sentences.p: Yǒu shénme kěyǐ bāng dào nǐ?
sentences.e: What can I help you with?

sentences.p: Qǐngwèn, jiàngyóu zài nǎlǐ?
sentences.e: Excuse me, where's the soy sauce?

sentences.p: Zài dì wǔ pái.
sentences.e: It's on aisle five.

sentences.p: Zhè bāo mǐ duōshao qián?
sentences.e: How much is this bag of rice?

sentences.p: Zhè bāo shí kuài.
sentences.e: This bag is ten dollars.

sentences.h: 麻烦你，我想要一磅鸡胸肉，多少钱？
sentences.p: Máfan nǐ, wǒ xiǎng yào yí bàng jīxiōngròu, duōshao qián?
sentences.e: Excuse me, I'd like a pound of chicken breast — how much is it?

sentences.p: Hái yào qítā dōngxi ma?
sentences.e: Would you like anything else?

sentences.p: Zài jiā yí bàng niúròu.
sentences.e: Add another pound of beef.

sentences.p: Wǒ huì zài cāntīng děng nǐ.
sentences.e: I'll wait for you at the restaurant.

sentences.p: Wǒ zài jiā lǐ.
sentences.e: I'm at home.

sentences.p: Wǒ zhàn zài jīchǎng lǐ.
sentences.e: I'm standing in the airport.

sentences.p: Wǒ huì zài cāntīng qiánmiàn děng nǐ.
sentences.e: I'll wait for you in front of the restaurant.

sentences.p: Nǐ yào qù xuéxiào hòumiàn jiàn tā.
sentences.e: You need to go behind the school to meet him.

sentences.p: Wǒ zuò zài nǐ duìmiàn.
sentences.e: I'm sitting opposite you.

sentences.p: Wǒ huì zài jīchǎng lǐmiàn jiē nǐ.
sentences.e: I'll pick you up inside the airport.

sentences.h: 爸爸看到那边有一个红绿灯。
sentences.p: Bàba kàn dào nàbiān yǒu yí ge hónglǜdēng.
sentences.e: Dad sees there's a traffic light over there.

sentences.p: Nǐ xiǎng yào wǒ xiàng nǎbiān zǒu?
sentences.e: Which way do you want me to go?

sentences.p: Nǐ zhàn zài wǒ shēnbiān.
sentences.e: You're standing beside me.

sentences.h: 放你的书包在我车的右手边。
sentences.p: Fàng nǐ de shūbāo zài wǒ chē de yòushǒubiān.
sentences.e: Put your backpack on the right-hand side of my car.

sentences.h: 请坐在我左手边的车位。
sentences.p: Qǐng zuò zài wǒ zuǒshǒubiān de chēwèi.
sentences.e: Please sit in the seat on my left.

sentences.p: Wǒ zài lùbiān zǒulù.
sentences.e: I'm walking along the roadside.

sentences.p: Wǒ zài xuéxiào wàimiàn jiē nǐ.
sentences.e: I'll pick you up outside the school.

sentences.h: 我要在学校里面等！外面很冷。
sentences.p: Wǒ yào zài xuéxiào lǐmiàn děng! Wàimiàn hěn lěng.
sentences.e: I want to wait inside the school! It's cold outside.

sentences.p: Zài zhè jiān cāntīng wàimiàn děng wǒ.
sentences.e: Wait for me outside this restaurant.

sentences.p: Nàlǐ pángbiān yǒu hěn duō rén.
sentences.e: There are a lot of people next to that place.

sentences.h: 我迷路了，可不可以帮我找到去公园的路？
sentences.p: Wǒ mílù le, kě bu kěyǐ bāng wǒ zhǎodào qù gōngyuán de lù?
sentences.e: I'm lost — could you help me find the way to the park?

sentences.p: Lǎo nǎinai, búyòng dānxīn.
sentences.e: Grandma, don't worry.

sentences.h: 你可以沿着这条路直走。
sentences.p: Nǐ kěyǐ yánzhe zhè tiáo lù zhí zǒu.
sentences.e: You can go straight along this road.

sentences.p: Dào zuǒbiān de lùkǒu jiù yòu zhuǎn.
sentences.e: At the junction on the left, turn right.

sentences.p: Zhí zǒu ránhòu yòu zhuǎn.
sentences.e: Go straight and then turn right.

sentences.h: 要不要我陪你一起走过去？
sentences.p: Yào bu yào wǒ péi nǐ yìqǐ zǒu guòqù?
sentences.e: Would you like me to walk over there with you?

sentences.p: Nǐ zhēn shì tài hǎo le.
sentences.e: You're too kind.

sentences.p: Nǐ shì yí ge shǎguā.
sentences.e: You're an idiot.
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.p: Dànshì wǒ xiǎng qù zhè jiān cāntīng.
sentences.e: But I want to go to this restaurant.
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.h: 但是我今晚八点要回家。
sentences.p: Dànshì wǒ jīnwǎn bā diǎn yào huí jiā.
sentences.e: But I have to go home at eight tonight.
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.p: Wǒ ài de nǚrén jiùshì nǐ.
sentences.e: The woman I love is precisely you.
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.h: 坏人就是坐在老师旁边的人。
sentences.p: Huàirén jiùshì zuò zài lǎoshī pángbiān de rén.
sentences.e: The villain is precisely the person sitting next to the teacher.
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.p: Wǒ shì shàng ge xīngqī huí jiā de.
sentences.e: It was last week that I went home.

sentences.h: 这件外套我是在美国买的。
sentences.p: Zhè jiàn wàitào wǒ shì zài Měiguó mǎi de.
sentences.e: I bought this jacket in America.
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.p: Dànshì nǐ jīnwǎn jǐ diǎn huílái?
sentences.e: But what time are you coming back tonight?
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.p: Wǒ xiǎng zhè bù shǒujī shì wǒ de.
sentences.e: I think this phone is mine.
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.p: Wǒ juéde tā shì xiǎng hē shuǐ de.
sentences.e: I think she wants to drink some water.
sentences.l: To Be or Not To Be

sentences.h: 我今天觉得自己很聪明。
sentences.p: Wǒ jīntiān juéde zìjǐ hěn cōngmíng.
sentences.e: Today I feel very clever.

sentences.h: 我昨天买了三部新手机。
sentences.p: Wǒ zuótiān mǎi le sān bù xīn shǒujī.
sentences.e: Yesterday I bought three new phones.

sentences.h: 我的同事明天要去见医生。
sentences.p: Wǒ de tóngshì míngtiān yào qù jiàn yīshēng.
sentences.e: My colleague has to go and see the doctor tomorrow.

sentences.p: Wǒ hòutiān yào qù shàngbān.
sentences.e: I have to go to work the day after tomorrow.

sentences.p: Wǒ hěn xiǎng xiàbān.
sentences.e: I really want to finish work.

sentences.h: 我觉得我上个星期应该要去帮我的老板。
sentences.p: Wǒ juéde wǒ shàng ge xīngqī yīnggāi yào qù bāng wǒ de lǎobǎn.
sentences.e: I feel I should have gone to help my boss last week.

sentences.h: 我想我下个星期要去帮我的同事。
sentences.p: Wǒ xiǎng wǒ xià ge xīngqī yào qù bāng wǒ de tóngshì.
sentences.e: I think next week I have to go and help my colleague.

sentences.h: 我们这个星期可以放假。
sentences.p: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqī kěyǐ fàngjià.
sentences.e: We can take time off this week.

sentences.h: 我上个月没有放假，所以我下个月要去旅游。
sentences.p: Wǒ shàng ge yuè méiyǒu fàngjià, suǒyǐ wǒ xià ge yuè yào qù lǚyóu.
sentences.e: I didn't take a holiday last month, so next month I'm going travelling.

sentences.h: 我这个月没有时间放假。
sentences.p: Wǒ zhè ge yuè méiyǒu shíjiān fàngjià.
sentences.e: I don't have time for a holiday this month.

sentences.p: Wǒ xiàwǔ shí diǎn bàn huì xiàbān.
sentences.e: I'll finish work at half past ten.

sentences.h: 我明天上午七点要去上班。
sentences.p: Wǒ míngtiān shàngwǔ qī diǎn yào qù shàngbān.
sentences.e: Tomorrow I have to go to work at 7am.

sentences.p: Wǒ wǎnshang yào qù xiūxi.
sentences.e: I need to rest tonight.

sentences.h: 他明天早上要五点起床。
sentences.p: Tā míngtiān zǎoshang yào wǔ diǎn qǐchuáng.
sentences.e: He has to get up at five tomorrow morning.

sentences.h: 我昨天晚上上班上到十点。
sentences.p: Wǒ zuótiān wǎnshang shàngbān shàng dào shí diǎn.
sentences.e: Last night I worked until ten.

sentences.h: 我明天想早上五点起床。
sentences.p: Wǒ míngtiān xiǎng zǎoshang wǔ diǎn qǐchuáng.
sentences.e: Tomorrow I want to get up at five in the morning.

sentences.h: 我下个星期可以晚上七点下班。
sentences.p: Wǒ xià ge xīngqī kěyǐ wǎnshang qī diǎn xiàbān.
sentences.e: Next week I can finish work at seven in the evening.

sentences.p: Xièxie nǐ zhǔnbèi zhè dùn fàn.
sentences.e: Thank you for preparing this meal.

sentences.p: Zhè ge cài hěn hǎochī.
sentences.e: This dish is delicious.

sentences.p: Zhè ge shì yòng shénme zuò de?
sentences.e: What is this made with?

sentences.h: 这个是用鸡肉和青菜做的。
sentences.p: Zhè ge shì yòng jīròu hé qīngcài zuò de.
sentences.e: It's made with chicken and greens.

sentences.h: 你平时最喜欢吃什么菜？
sentences.p: Nǐ píngshí zuì xǐhuan chī shénme cài?
sentences.e: What's your usual favourite dish?

sentences.h: 我也喜欢吃麻婆豆腐，还有炒面。
sentences.p: Wǒ yě xǐhuan chī mápó dòufu, hái yǒu chǎomiàn.
sentences.e: I like mapo tofu too, and fried noodles as well.

sentences.p: Xūyào bāngmáng shōu wǎn ma?
sentences.e: Do you need help clearing the dishes?

sentences.p: Búyòng búyòng.
sentences.e: No need, no need.

sentences.h: 谢谢你的招待，这次真的吃得好饱。
sentences.p: Xièxie nǐ de zhāodài, zhè cì zhēn de chī de hǎo bǎo.
sentences.e: Thank you for having me — I'm really full this time.

sentences.p: Nǐmen mǎi le fángzi le ma?
sentences.e: Have you bought a house yet?

sentences.h: 还没买，我们现在还在租房子。
sentences.p: Hái méi mǎi, wǒmen xiànzài hái zài zū fángzi.
sentences.e: Not yet — we're still renting at the moment.

sentences.h: 租房子也不错，不过你们应该早点买房子。
sentences.p: Zū fángzi yě búcuò, búguò nǐmen yīnggāi zǎodiǎn mǎi fángzi.
sentences.e: Renting is fine too, but you should buy a house sooner.

sentences.h: 我知道，但是我想等我毕业之后再买。
sentences.p: Wǒ zhīdào, dànshì wǒ xiǎng děng wǒ bìyè zhīhòu zài mǎi.
sentences.e: I know, but I want to wait until after I graduate to buy.

sentences.h: 现在买房子比较好，因为房价可能会升。
sentences.p: Xiànzài mǎi fángzi bǐjiào hǎo, yīnwèi fángjià kěnéng huì shēng.
sentences.e: It's better to buy now, because house prices may rise.

sentences.h: 但是现在的贷款利率很高，压力太大了。
sentences.p: Dànshì xiànzài de dàikuǎn lìlǜ hěn gāo, yālì tài dà le.
sentences.e: But mortgage rates are very high right now — the pressure is too much.

sentences.p: Nà nǐmen dǎsuàn děng duōjiǔ ne?
sentences.e: So how long are you planning to wait?

sentences.h: 我希望等工作稳定之后再买房子。
sentences.p: Wǒ xīwàng děng gōngzuò wěndìng zhīhòu zài mǎi fángzi.
sentences.e: I hope to buy a house once my job is stable.

sentences.p: Wǒ zài yínháng gōngzuò.
sentences.e: I work at a bank.

sentences.p: Wǒ jiǔ diǎn shàngbān.
sentences.e: I start work at nine.

sentences.p: Nǐ kěyǐ guòlái bāngmáng ma?
sentences.e: Can you come over and help?

sentences.h: 我不知道怎么用中文讲。
sentences.p: Wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme yòng Zhōngwén jiǎng.
sentences.e: I don't know how to say this in Chinese.

sentences.h: 我的朋友不知道怎么上去。
sentences.p: Wǒ de péngyou bù zhīdào zěnme shàngqù.
sentences.e: My friend doesn't know how to get up there.

sentences.h: 没有楼梯，我不知道怎么下去。
sentences.p: Méiyǒu lóutī, wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme xiàqù.
sentences.e: There are no stairs — I don't know how to get down.

sentences.p: Qǐngwèn zhè ge shì duōshao qián?
sentences.e: Excuse me, how much is this?

sentences.p: Nǐ dài le duōshao qián chūlái?
sentences.e: How much money did you bring out?

sentences.p: Yīyuàn lǐmiàn hái yǒu duōshao rén?
sentences.e: How many people are still in the hospital?

sentences.p: Wǒ hái méiyǒu chīfàn.
sentences.e: I haven't eaten yet.

sentences.p: Xiànzài shì jǐ diǎnzhōng?
sentences.e: What time is it now?

sentences.h: 你身边有几个人喜欢你？
sentences.p: Nǐ shēnbiān yǒu jǐ ge rén xǐhuan nǐ?
sentences.e: How many people around you like you?

sentences.p: Nǐ xiǎng kàn lánqiú háishi zúqiú?
sentences.e: Do you want to watch basketball or football?

sentences.p: Tā zài qiánmiàn háishi hòumiàn?
sentences.e: Is he in front or behind?

sentences.h: 你喜欢吃鸡肉还是牛肉？
sentences.p: Nǐ xǐhuan chī jīròu háishi niúròu?
sentences.e: Do you prefer chicken or beef?

sentences.h: 我不知道这个是我的篮球还是他的篮球。
sentences.p: Wǒ bù zhīdào zhè ge shì wǒ de lánqiú háishi tā de lánqiú.
sentences.e: I don't know whether this is my basketball or his.

sentences.h: 我想知道她喜欢白色还是红色。
sentences.p: Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào tā xǐhuan báisè háishi hóngsè.
sentences.e: I want to know whether she likes white or red.

sentences.h: 我们现在可以上去或者留在这里。
sentences.p: Wǒmen xiànzài kěyǐ shàngqù huòzhě liú zài zhèlǐ.
sentences.e: We can go up now or stay here.

sentences.h: 我们今天可以看书或者看电影。
sentences.p: Wǒmen jīntiān kěyǐ kàn shū huòzhě kàn diànyǐng.
sentences.e: Today we can read a book or watch a film.

sentences.h: 你为什么要选这间餐厅？
sentences.p: Nǐ wèishénme yào xuǎn zhè jiān cāntīng?
sentences.e: Why did you pick this restaurant?

sentences.h: 我在上班，我怎么可以下来？
sentences.p: Wǒ zài shàngbān, wǒ zěnme kěyǐ xiàlái?
sentences.e: I'm at work — how can I come down?

sentences.p: Māma, nǐ xiǎng zhǔ fàn háishi zhōu?
sentences.e: Mum, do you want to make rice or congee?

sentences.p: Nǐ qù guo Zhōngguó le ma?
sentences.e: Have you been to China?

sentences.p: Tāmen zuò wán gōngkè le ma?
sentences.e: Have they finished their homework?

sentences.p: Nǐ kāi guo zhè ge hézi le ma?
sentences.e: Have you opened this box before?

sentences.p: Tā shì wǒmen de sījī ma?
sentences.e: Is he our driver?

sentences.p: Tā zuótiān huí dào jiā ma?
sentences.e: Did he get home yesterday?

sentences.p: Nǐ hái méi xiǎng hǎo ma?
sentences.e: Haven't you made up your mind yet?

sentences.p: Zhèxiē dōngxi dōu shì nǐ de ma?
sentences.e: Are all these things yours?

sentences.p: Māma shì zuótiān lái de ma?
sentences.e: Did Mum come yesterday?

sentences.p: Nǐ shì hěn xǐhuan kàn shū de ma?
sentences.e: Do you really like reading?

sentences.p: Nǐ xiànzài yào guòlái kāihuì ma?
sentences.e: Are you coming over for the meeting now?

sentences.p: Tā shì nǐ de nánpéngyou ma?
sentences.e: Is he your boyfriend?

sentences.p: Nǐ dǎkāi nà ge hézi le ma?
sentences.e: Have you opened that box?

sentences.p: Zhè ge shì shéi de qiánbāo?
sentences.e: Whose wallet is this?

sentences.p: Zhè ge mén shì shéi dǎkāi de?
sentences.e: Who opened this door?

sentences.p: Zhè ge shì shénme?
sentences.e: What is this?

sentences.p: Nǐ zhǎodào shénme?
sentences.e: What did you find?

sentences.p: Xiànzài yǒu shéi xiǎng kāi mén jìnlái?
sentences.e: Who wants to open the door and come in now?

sentences.p: Māma gēn nǐ shuō le shénme?
sentences.e: What did Mum say to you?

sentences.h: 所以女儿会什么时候出去？
sentences.p: Suǒyǐ nǚ'ér huì shénme shíhou chūqù?
sentences.e: So when will your daughter go out?

sentences.p: Nǐ hǎo, nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
sentences.e: Hello, what's your name?

sentences.p: Nǐ hǎo, jiào wǒ Xiǎo… jiù kěyǐ le.
sentences.e: Hello, you can just call me Xiao-…

sentences.h: 你的家好漂亮啊，装修得很有品味。
sentences.p: Nǐ de jiā hǎo piàoliang a, zhuāngxiū de hěn yǒu pǐnwèi.
sentences.e: Your home is lovely — it's decorated very tastefully.

sentences.p: Xièxie, nǐ shì nǎlǐ rén?
sentences.e: Thanks — where are you from?

sentences.h: 我是香港人，但是我小时候在英国长大。
sentences.p: Wǒ shì Xiānggǎng rén, dànshì wǒ xiǎoshíhou zài Yīngguó zhǎngdà.
sentences.e: I'm from Hong Kong, but I grew up in the UK.

sentences.h: 我是英国人，家里人是从香港来的。
sentences.p: Wǒ shì Yīngguó rén, jiālǐ rén shì cóng Xiānggǎng lái de.
sentences.e: I'm British; my family originally came from Hong Kong.

sentences.p: Tīngshuō nǐ huì yìxiē pǔtōnghuà.
sentences.e: I hear you know some Mandarin.

sentences.h: 是啊，刚刚开始学，还有很多东西要学！
sentences.p: Shì a, gānggāng kāishǐ xué, hái yǒu hěn duō dōngxi yào xué!
sentences.e: Yes, I've only just started learning — there's still a lot to learn!

sentences.p: Xiànzài zài nǎlǐ gōngzuò?
sentences.e: Where do you work now?

sentences.h: 我在一家科技公司工作，负责市场推广。
sentences.p: Wǒ zài yì jiā kējì gōngsī gōngzuò, fùzé shìchǎng tuīguǎng.
sentences.e: I work at a tech company, in marketing.

sentences.p: Nǐ píngshí yǒu shénme àihào?
sentences.e: What are your hobbies?

sentences.p: Wǒ xǐhuan shuìjiào hé dǎ lánqiú.
sentences.e: I like sleeping and playing basketball.

sentences.p: Bàba, zuìjìn gōngzuò zěnmeyàng?
sentences.e: Dad, how's work been lately?

sentences.h: 有点忙，有很多事情要处理。你呢？
sentences.p: Yǒudiǎn máng, yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào chǔlǐ. Nǐ ne?
sentences.e: A bit busy — there's a lot to deal with. And you?

sentences.h: 我也很忙，不过还算顺利。
sentences.p: Wǒ yě hěn máng, búguò hái suàn shùnlì.
sentences.e: I'm busy too, but it's going reasonably smoothly.

sentences.p: Nà jiù hǎo, yālì dà ma?
sentences.e: That's good — is the pressure heavy?

sentences.h: 有点大，不过我还可以应付。
sentences.p: Yǒudiǎn dà, búguò wǒ hái kěyǐ yìngfu.
sentences.e: A bit heavy, but I can still manage.

sentences.p: Zuìjìn shēntǐ zěnmeyàng?
sentences.e: How's your health been recently?

sentences.h: 你们打算什么时候生孩子啊？
sentences.p: Nǐmen dǎsuàn shénme shíhou shēng háizi a?
sentences.e: When are you planning to have children?

sentences.h: 我觉得我们可以再等一下，晚点再生孩子。
sentences.p: Wǒ juéde wǒmen kěyǐ zài děng yíxià, wǎndiǎn zài shēng háizi.
sentences.e: I think we can wait a bit longer and have children later.

sentences.p: Wèishénme ya? Nǐ xiànzài niánqīng.
sentences.e: Why? You're young now.

sentences.p: Zǎodiǎn shēng háizi duì shēntǐ hǎo.
sentences.e: Having children earlier is better for your health.

sentences.p: Búguò wǒ hái zài dúshū.
sentences.e: But I'm still studying.

sentences.h: 我想毕业之后再生孩子。
sentences.p: Wǒ xiǎng bìyè zhīhòu zài shēng háizi.
sentences.e: I want to have children after I graduate.

sentences.h: 生孩子其实不会影响你读书的。
sentences.p: Shēng háizi qíshí bú huì yǐngxiǎng nǐ dúshū de.
sentences.e: Having a child actually won't affect your studies.

sentences.p: Wǒmen yě huì bāngmáng zhàogù de.
sentences.e: We'll help take care of them too.

sentences.h: 我们希望能准备好再生孩子。
sentences.p: Wǒmen xīwàng néng zhǔnbèi hǎo zài shēng háizi.
sentences.e: We hope to be properly ready before having children.

sentences.p: Xièxie nǐ de lǐjiě.
sentences.e: Thank you for understanding.

sentences.p: Zhǔnbèi bān qù Xiānggǎng.
sentences.e: Getting ready to move to Hong Kong.

sentences.h: 你可不可以给我一个机会？
sentences.p: Nǐ kě bu kěyǐ gěi wǒ yí ge jīhuì?
sentences.e: Could you give me a chance?

sentences.p: Wǒ huì shuō yìdiǎn Zhōngwén.
sentences.e: I can speak a little Chinese.

sentences.h: 没有没有，我的中文不太好。
sentences.p: Méiyǒu méiyǒu, wǒ de Zhōngwén bú tài hǎo.
sentences.e: No no, my Chinese isn't very good.

sentences.p: Wǒ bù zhīdào zhè ge dìfang.
sentences.e: I don't know this place.

sentences.p: Zhè ge lǎoshī hěn cōngmíng.
sentences.e: This teacher is very smart.

sentences.h: 你要看那部电影！很好看。
sentences.p: Nǐ yào kàn nà bù diànyǐng! Hěn hǎokàn.
sentences.e: You have to watch that film! It's really good.

grammar.t: 在 before a verb = ongoing action
grammar.s: Cantonese 緊 (gan2) becomes 在 (zài), but it goes BEFORE the verb, not after it.

ex.p: Wǒ zài zuò gōngkè.
Biǎogē zài chīfàn.

grammar.s: Cantonese 咗 (zo2) becomes 了 (le). It attaches to the verb or sits at the end of the clause.

ex.p: Tā yǐjīng bìyè le.
Wǒ dào jiā le.

grammar.t: 和 = with / and — verb comes after
grammar.s: 和 (hé) replaces Cantonese 同 (tung4). The verb follows the 和-phrase, not before it.

ex.p: Nǐ kě bu kěyǐ hé wǒ chūqù?
ex.e: Can you come out with me?

grammar.t: 是…的 states an established fact
grammar.s: Cantonese 係…㗎 becomes 是…的 (shì…de). Used to emphasise when, where or how something happened.

ex.p: Wǒ shì shàng ge xīngqī huí jiā de.
ex.e: It was last week that I went home.

ex.h: 这件外套我是在美国买的。
ex.p: Zhè jiàn wàitào wǒ shì zài Měiguó mǎi de.
ex.e: I bought this jacket in America.

grammar.l: To Be or Not To Be

grammar.s: Cantonese is 畀 + direct object + indirect object. Mandarin reverses it: 给 + person + thing.

ex.p: Wǒ gěi nǐ yì bēi shuǐ.
ex.e: I give you a glass of water.

grammar.t: 还是 vs 或者 — two kinds of 'or'
grammar.s: 还是 (háishi) is for questions offering a choice. 或者 (huòzhě) is for statements.

ex.p: Nǐ xiǎng kàn lánqiú háishi zúqiú?
ex.e: Do you want to watch basketball or football?

ex.h: 我们今天可以看书或者看电影。
ex.p: Wǒmen jīntiān kěyǐ kàn shū huòzhě kàn diànyǐng.
ex.e: Today we can read or watch a film.

grammar.t: 是 vs 对 — two kinds of 'yes'
grammar.s: 是 (shì) answers a yes/no question. 对 (duì) confirms that something is correct or agrees with it.

grammar.t: 这 / 那 / 哪 — this, that, which
grammar.s: Cantonese 呢/嗰/邊 map to 这 (zhè) / 那 (nà) / 哪 (nǎ). Note 那 and 哪 differ only by tone.

ex.p: Wǒ bù zhīdào zhè ge dìfang.

grammar.s: Cantonese 度 (dou6) becomes 里 (lǐ): 这里 here, 那里 there, 哪里 where. Also used for being inside something.

ex.p: Wǒ zài jiā lǐ.

grammar.s: 前面 in front · 后面 behind · 上面 above · 下面 below · 对面 opposite · 里面 inside · 外面 outside.

ex.p: Wǒ zuò zài nǐ duìmiàn.

grammar.s: 这边 this side · 那边 that side · 身边 at one's side · 路边 roadside · 左手边 left · 右手边 right · 旁边 beside.

ex.p: Nǐ zhàn zài wǒ shēnbiān.

grammar.s: 个 (gè) general · 本 (běn) books · 只 (zhī) animals · 件 (jiàn) clothing · 部 (bù) phones and films · 条 (tiáo) roads · 间 (jiān) rooms and shops · 些 (xiē) several.

ex.p: zhè běn shū
nà zhī gǒu

grammar.s: Cantonese 點 (dim2) becomes 怎么 (zěnme).

ex.h: 我不知道怎么用中文讲。
ex.p: Wǒ bù zhīdào zěnme yòng Zhōngwén jiǎng.
ex.e: I don't know how to say it in Chinese.

grammar.s: 多少 (duōshao) for open-ended or large quantities. 几 (jǐ) when the answer is expected to be small, and for telling the time.

ex.p: Nǐ dài le duōshao qián chūlái?
ex.e: How much money did you bring?

ex.p: Xiànzài shì jǐ diǎnzhōng?

grammar.t: Question words: 谁 / 什么 / 哪里 / 什么时候
grammar.s: 谁 (shéi) who · 什么 (shénme) what · 哪里 (nǎlǐ) where · 什么时候 (shénme shíhou) when.

ex.p: Zhè ge shì shéi de qiánbāo?

grammar.t: Asking without 吗: 了吗 and 的吗
grammar.s: Cantonese 未呀 becomes 了吗 (le ma) for 'have you yet?'. 㗎 becomes 的吗 (de ma) for confirming a characteristic.

ex.p: Nǐ qù guo Zhōngguó le ma?
Zhèxiē dōngxi dōu shì nǐ de ma?

grammar.s: Number + 点 + number + 分. 半 (bàn) for half past. Add 上午 / 下午 / 早上 / 晚上 before it for am/pm.

ex.p: shí diǎn èrshíwǔ fēn
bā diǎn bàn

grammar.t: Last vs next: 上/下 vs 昨/明 vs 去/明
grammar.s: Day uses 昨 / 明. Week and month use 上 / 下. Year uses 去 / 明. Mixing these up is the most common slip.

ex.h: 上个月 · 这个月 · 下个月
ex.p: shàng ge yuè · zhè ge yuè · xià ge yuè

ex.h: 去年 · 今年 · 明年
ex.p: qùnián · jīnnián · míngnián

grammar.t: 周 vs 星期 vs 礼拜
grammar.s: 周 (zhōu) takes no 个: 上周, 这周, 下周. 星期 and 礼拜 take 个: 上个星期, 下个礼拜.
前 (qián) means 'ago' looking backwards from now — 两周前 two weeks ago. 上 (shàng) means the previous one — 上周 last week.

grammar.t: 对 vs 的 with 过敏
grammar.s: Use 对 (duì) for 'allergic to X': 我对花生过敏. 的 (de) is for describing possession, not the target of a reaction.

ex.p: Wǒ duì huāshēng guòmǐn.

grammar.t: 就 vs 然后 — two kinds of 'then'
grammar.s: 就 (jiù) means 'then, as an immediate result'. 然后 (ránhòu) means 'and afterwards' in a sequence.

ex.p: Dào zuǒbiān de lùkǒu jiù yòu zhuǎn.
ex.e: At the left junction, turn right.

ex.p: Zhí zǒu ránhòu yòu zhuǎn.
ex.e: Go straight and then turn right.

grammar.t: 觉得 vs 想 vs 认为
grammar.s: 觉得 (juéde) is the everyday 'I think / it feels to me'. 想 (xiǎng) mostly means 'want to' or 'miss'. 认为 (rènwéi) is formal 'hold the view that'.

ex.h: 我觉得我们可以再等一下。
ex.p: Wǒ juéde wǒmen kěyǐ zài děng yíxià.
ex.e: I think we can wait a bit longer.

grammar.s: 不会 (bú huì) expresses a prediction or likelihood. 不是 (bú shì) denies an identity or a fact.

ex.h: 生孩子其实不会影响你读书的。
ex.p: Shēng háizi qíshí bú huì yǐngxiǎng nǐ dúshū de.
ex.e: Having a child won't affect your studies.

grammar.s: 东西 (dōngxi) is for tangible things you can hold. 事情 (shìqing) is for matters, tasks and abstract things.

ex.p: Yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào chǔlǐ.
ex.e: There's a lot to deal with.

grammar.s: 工作 (gōngzuò) is your job — what you do and where. 上班 (shàngbān) is the act of going to work, about schedule.

ex.p: Wǒ zài yínháng gōngzuò.
Wǒ jiǔ diǎn shàngbān.

grammar.s: 看 (kàn) is to look at or watch. 见 (jiàn) is to see or meet someone.

ex.p: Nǐ yào qù xuéxiào hòumiàn jiàn tā.
ex.e: Go behind the school to meet him.

grammar.s: 找 (zhǎo) is to look for or search. 在 (zài) is to be located at.

grammar.t: 放假 vs 房价 — mind the tones
grammar.s: 放假 fàngjià = to take a holiday. 房价 fángjià = house prices. Same syllables, different first tone.
冇 (mou5) becomes 没有 (méiyǒu). Used both for 'don't have' and to negate a past action.

ex.p: Gēge méiyǒu chūqù.

grammar.s: 仲 (zung6) becomes 还 (hái): 还在 still there, 还没 not yet, 还有 still have.

ex.p: Wǒ hái méiyǒu chīfàn.

grammar.s: 在读 (zài dú) literally reads 'ing-study'. The aspect marker leads in Mandarin, the opposite of the Cantonese order.

ex.p: Wǒ xiànzài zài dú dà sì.
